summary: Space Pioneers is an interactive educational strategy game that takes players on an exciting journey across the eight planets of our Solar System. The game combines space exploration, NASA-based scientific information, educational quizzes, rocket engineering, resource management, and real-time strategic battles. Players discover planetary facts, complete challenges, customize rockets, select elemental weapons, and build armies to overcome different enemies. Through its interactive learning system, the project encourages curiosity about astronomy, scientific thinking, problem-solving, and creativity. Our goal is to transform space education into an engaging experience where players learn by exploring, experimenting, and making strategic decisions. Space Pioneers demonstrates how digital games can make scientific knowledge more accessible, enjoyable, and memorable.
